每丢弃一张牌，就将一张[gold]{IfUpgraded:show:小刀+|小刀}[/gold]添加至你的[gold]手牌[/gold]。

cards.name: Strangle
cards.title: Strangle
cards.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Whenever you play a card this turn, the enemy loses {StranglePower:diff()} HP.
cards.descriptionZh:
造成{Damage:diff()}点伤害。
你在这个回合内每出一张牌，该名敌人都会失去{StranglePower:diff()}点生命。

cards.name: SuckerPunch
cards.title: Sucker Punch
cards.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Apply {WeakPower:diff()} [gold]Weak[/gold].
cards.descriptionZh:
造成{Damage:diff()}点伤害。
给予{WeakPower:diff()}层[gold]虚弱[/gold]。

cards.name: Suppress
cards.title: Suppress
cards.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Apply {WeakPower:diff()} [gold]Weak[/gold].
cards.descriptionZh:
造成{Damage:diff()}点伤害。
给予{WeakPower:diff()}层[gold]虚弱[/gold]。

cards.name: Tactician
cards.title: Tactician
cards.description: Gain {Energy:energyIcons()}.
cards.descriptionZh: 获得{Energy:energyIcons()}。

cards.name: TheHunt
cards.title: The Hunt
cards.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
If [gold]Fatal[/gold], gain an additional card reward.
cards.descriptionZh:
造成{Damage:diff()}点伤害。
[gold]斩杀[/gold]时，额外获得一次卡牌奖励。

cards.name: ToolsOfTheTrade
cards.title: Tools of the Trade
cards.description: At the start of your turn, draw 1 card and discard 1 card.
cards.descriptionZh: 在你的回合开始时，抽1张牌，丢弃1张牌。

cards.name: Tracking
cards.title: Tracking
cards.description: [gold]Weak[/gold] enemies take 50% more damage from Attacks.
cards.descriptionZh: 处于[gold]虚弱[/gold]状态的敌人受到的攻击伤害增加50%。

cards.name: Untouchable
cards.title: Untouchable
cards.description: Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
cards.descriptionZh: 获得{Block:diff()}点[gold]格挡[/gold]。

cards.name: UpMySleeve
cards.title: Up My Sleeve
cards.description:
Add {Cards:diff()} [gold]{Cards:plural:Shiv|Shivs}[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
Reduce this card's cost by 1.
cards.descriptionZh:
将{Cards:diff()}张[gold]小刀[/gold]加入你的[gold]手牌[/gold]。
这张牌的耗能减少1。

cards.name: WellLaidPlans
cards.title: Well-Laid Plans
cards.description: At the end of your turn, you no longer discard your [gold]Hand[/gold].
cards.descriptionZh: 在你的回合结束时，你不再丢弃你的[gold]手牌[/gold]。

cards.name: WraithForm
cards.title: Wraith Form
cards.description:
Gain {IntangiblePower:diff()} [gold]Intangible[/gold].
At the start of your turn, lose {WraithFormPower:diff()} [gold]Dexterity[/gold].
cards.descriptionZh:
获得{IntangiblePower:diff()}[gold]无实体[/gold]。
在你的回合开始时，失去{WraithFormPower:diff()}点[gold]敏捷[/gold]。
